summary: Iteration 49 — Backend-only validation of the link_code sparse→partial unique index migration fix. (A) Reproduced the production E11000 bug on test_database: dropped link_code_1 and recreated it as sparse+unique; first null-link_code insert OK, second insert failed with E11000 (confirmed mechanism). Cleaned throwaways. (B) `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` → startup succeeded ('Application startup complete', no Traceback); `db.players.getIndexes()` shows link_code_1 with unique:true + partialFilterExpression:{link_code:{$type:'string'}} and NO 'sparse'; GET /api/public/tournaments → 200. (C) With the partial index, two null link_code inserts BOTH succeed; two duplicate string 'QA-DUP-1' inserts: second fails with E11000 (uniqueness preserved). All 3 throwaway docs deleted; final null link_code count = 0. (D) seed_match_engine executed twice via asyncio.run — no DuplicateKeyError (returns early because matches already exist for la-serie-a-dei-bambini). Total players = 57, null link_code count unchanged at 0. (E) ensure_link_codes called twice inside one event loop — no exception, index unchanged, 0 backfills. (F) CI regression: scripts/qa_admin.py create → pytest tests/test_security_phase2.py tests/test_owner_hierarchy.py → 43 passed in 27.22s → scripts/qa_admin.py delete.
critical_code_review_comments: linkcodes.py:ensure_link_codes — migration logic correctly treats legacy sparse index as needing drop+recreate (checks cur.get('sparse')) and compares partialFilterExpression. Wrapped in try/except so an index error never aborts startup. Good.

seed.py:seed_match_engine — Player insert now uses linkcodes.new_code() (line 303), so new seeded players never have null link_code. Function early-returns if matches already exist, keeping it idempotent. No crash on repeated calls.
Minor: ensure_link_codes backfill loop retries up to 5 times per player but silently drops a player if all 5 random codes collide (never happens in practice but no error log). Low priority.

success_rate.backend: 100% (43/43 CI tests, index migration verified, seed idempotent)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix for the production startup crash (sparse unique index → DuplicateKeyError on seeded null link_code) is verified end-to-end on preview DB. Current index on players: link_code_1 {unique:true, partialFilterExpression:{link_code:{$type:'string'}}}. Backend logs clean. CI suite (test_security_phase2 + test_owner_hierarchy) = 43/43 green.
rca of the issue: MongoDB sparse+unique indexes DO index documents whose indexed field is explicitly set to null — only fully-missing fields are skipped. seed.py inserted Player docs with link_code=None, which the sparse unique index saw as duplicate null keys → E11000 → FastAPI startup failed. Fix: (a) replace sparse with partialFilterExpression:{link_code:{$type:'string'}} so nulls are completely ignored by the index; (b) seed with linkcodes.new_code() so no seeded doc has null link_code anyway. Both are in place and verified via reproduction + post-fix validation.
